notes.title: Second update on 19 June
notes.notes:
To all warriors:

[Story of Infinity:Xia] will be updated on steam on June 19, 2023 ,this update is feature and system content.

1. Inheritance system changes: After the number of inherits reaches the upper limit of six, you can choose one to replace when you get a new Inheritance.
2. Changed boss randomization: On high level Scene or Difficulty 5, double boss rooms will appear randomly.


The above content can help you to explore adventure, We wish you a happy trip! Thank you for your support.

YOUGU Studio
06.19.2023

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
To all warriors:

[Story of Infinity:Xia Demo] has been updated on steam on June 9th, 2023. Welcome to download and experience! In order to make you familiar with the game as soon as possible, the updated content is announced as follows:


1. Updated the equipment system, updated the role unlock function, updated the role achievement system.
2. Due to the above updates, the game save data and the previous version of the game are not compatible, so you need to restart the new game.  We apologize for the inconvenience caused to the warriors.  The save data of this Demo version can be synchronously compatible with the full official version after sale.
3, updated the new Wu(Skill): Magic Machine.
4. Updated several new Secret book .
5. Updated several new Enemies.
6. Optimized some Wu(Skill).


The above content can help you to explore adventure, We wish you a happy trip!


[Story of Infinity:Xia] the official full version will be launched on Steam on June the middle and last ten days, and we are also stepping up the production of more content to enrich the official version, thank you for your support.

YOUGU Studio

notes.title: "Story Of Infinity: Xia" Update
notes.notes:
[h2]To all warriors:[/h2]

[Story of Infinity:Xia] has been updated on steam on April 21th, 2023. Welcome to download and experience! In order to make you familiar with the game as soon as possible, the updated content is announced as follows:

1.Redesigned the Sprint[Space] skill: Now the Sprint skill consumes Sprint points. When you have enough Sprint points, you can perform multiple Space movements and dodges.
2.Two new basic attributes have been added to the character's attributes: Sprint points and Sprint recovery rate.
3.Fixed the problem of speed resetting to zero after using Sprint[Space].
4.Optimized the pickup judgment for Weapons, Secret book, and Five-Elements Treasures, making it easier to click.
5.The Tao Law page has added a give up function, but it still consumes Five-Elements Treasures.
6.Lowered difficulty: a campsite that can be used for recovery has been added to the second level of the dungeon.
7.Adjusted the materials required to upgrade Elements Energy.

The above content can help you to explore adventure, We wish you a happy trip!


YOUGU Studio
04.21.2023
